floors.floor_derivation: conservative fractions (about 10% of anchor contexts and about 8-15% of the exposed Development signal/paired counts) used only to stop sparse-sample over-reading; failing a floor yields INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never NOT_SUPPORTED

confirmation_control.derivation: exposed Development shares are CN 0.2831 and US 0.3569; the floor is roughly 8-15 percentage points below them and marks a materially weaker confirmation yield

invalidation_control.derivation: exposed Development shares are CN 0.2260 and US 0.2367; the bound adds an independent-sample tolerance of roughly 11-12 percentage points

space_improvement.median_min_derivation: about 38% of the exposed Development paired median gain of 0.2643 R; a smaller independent-sample gain is treated as too small to carry an earlier-entry design

decision.reason: Both markets met the pre-registered space, invalidation and confirmation gates; this supports applying for a separate execution-cost/net-return stage and authorizes no production policy. CN: FIRST_STAGE_SUPPORTED_FOR_SECOND_STAGE_APPLICATION (cohort 1081, executable early signals 461, paired later-CONFIRMED 153, median paired gain 0.275 R, sign-test p 2.05e-40, invalidation share 0.204, confirmed share 0.332; failed floors none; failed gates none); US: FIRST_STAGE_SUPPORTED_FOR_SECOND_STAGE_APPLICATION (cohort 1210, executable early signals 525, paired later-CONFIRMED 175, median paired gain 0.238 R, sign-test p 3.85e-41, invalidation share 0.234, confirmed share 0.335; failed floors none; failed gates none).

fixed_comparison.setup_scope: SETUP_01 (Wave 2 -> Wave 3) Wave2 anchor contexts only

aggregate.paired_definition: (incumbent exact next-session OPEN - early exact next-session OPEN) / Wave1 R
